title: dickie02.WAD, issue 2.
author: Richard Wiles
description: Second release, first wad completed to the author's satisfaction. Lighting pass and a less garish sky after issue 1; a start-room bug was removed.

reviews.text: Two areas linked by a blue door. Texture mix of cave, metal, wood, redbrick feels blended. Early SSG grab is annoyingly tricky with barons on a narrow ledge.
Poor start with a dark cavern maze. Improves outdoors. Nice balance of health, ammo, and monsters, but too many chaingunner balconies.
Special kind of atmosphere. Old-school 1995 feel without the usual shortcomings of those maps.
